why:
The briefs cover all four must_catch items.
1. Builder step 7 says to "Run `npm install` at the repo root so `package-lock.json` picks up the new workspace, and commit the updated lockfile". It also explains that `npm ci` fails when the lockfile is out of sync.
2. Builder step 6 says to "Replace that with a bullet that lists `packages/jsonl-lint`". That replaces the "no tools yet" statement rather than adding a line.
3. Verifier check 6 runs the root `npm ci && npm test` and passes only if "its output shows the jsonl-lint tests ran". Check 4 also fails if "none run". Together these would catch tests being skipped silently.
4. Verifier check 6 uses gh api to find the PR whose body contains the exact Closes line. It requires `head_sha` to equal the checked-out commit and the `test` check run at that sha to be completed with success.
